status: Standard thread data: coarse pitches, tap drills and ISO 286 fits. Replace with your own standards.
reach_clearance_note: depth + 3.5 mm reproduces the scenario's 'D9.8 drill needs a flute of at least 55 mm' (51.5 + 3.5); replace with the shop's rule
ream_allowance_note: diameter stock left for the reamer, by hole diameter (up to and including); the pre-drill is rounded down to 0.1 mm
default_stock_note: used when the request gives no stock: a pre-sized blank with stock on the top face only
tap_drill_note: standard ISO metric coarse tap-drill sizes for 6H internal threads (ISO 2306 / DIN 336); other pitches use major - pitch rounded to 0.1 mm. Verify against the tap supplier.
it_grades_note: ISO 286-1 standard tolerance grades, in micrometres, for diameters up to and including each range limit. Only H holes (lower deviation 0) are interpreted from a fit code.
